model: Independent orbit markers; circular coplanar Daphnis; Saturn spherical Hill approximation
incoming_sampling: Nested Halton points; b probability proportional to b, initial encounter ages uniform over four periods. Equal 1/N weights. Inner strip is an exact reflected copy.
movie: 97 frames covering six periods around Saturn; no collisions, mutual particle gravity, or brightness model. Radial direction stretched; marker sizes are graphical.
mean_shift_epoch: Outer tracks only, measured six periods after each nominal conjunction, not at one common packet time.
profile_epoch: Common packet time of four periods; lower tenth percentile in 15 fixed 40 km bins from 100 to 700 km downstream.

interpolation_checks.method: Same three tracks, 2401 versus 4801 interpolation samples
Same three tracks, 2401 versus 4801 interpolation samples

scope: Agreement tests marker sampling in this specified packet. It does not validate omitted collisions, domain choices, or the full Cassini observations.
